user.title: Connect your receipt printer
user.description: Enter the printer's IP address. Give it a static IP or a DHCP reservation so it doesn't move. Tiny Press talks raw ESC/POS on port 9100.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the Epson TM printer.
data_description.port: Raw printing port. Epson TM printers use 9100.

discovery_confirm.title: Epson receipt printer found
discovery_confirm.description: Set up the receipt printer at {host} as Tiny Press?

paper.title: Paper
paper.description: Pick the paper roll width loaded in the printer. On the TM-m30III, 58 mm paper also needs the 58 mm roll guide fitted and the width changed in the printer's settings.

error.no_status: Connected, but the device didn't answer ESC/POS status requests. Is it an Epson TM receipt printer?
error.test_page_failed: The test page couldn't be sent. Untick it to continue, or check the printer.

abort.not_receipt_printer: The discovered Epson device doesn't answer receipt-printer status requests.

data.ai_jokes: Use AI for jokes and fun facts

data_description.max_length_mm: Any print longer than this is trimmed, so a runaway print can't empty the roll.
data_description.poll_interval: How often to read paper and cover status. Status is never read while printing.
data_description.ai_task_entity: Optional. Used for bedtime stories in a later version, and for jokes and fun facts if you switch that on below.
data_description.ai_jokes: Off (recommended): jokes and facts come from Tiny Press's bundled, human-written lists, each with a credited source. On: ask the AI task entity first and fall back to the bundled lists.
data_description.weather_entity: Used by the Weather print and the morning slip. Not needed if you only have one weather entity.
data_description.calendar_entities: Today's events from these calendars print on the morning slip, all-day events first.
data_description.todo_entities: Optional. Unchecked items from these lists print as checkboxes. Leave empty for no to-dos.
data_description.morning_bottom: What prints at the end of the morning slip.

add_kid.title: Add a kid
add_kid.description: Profiles set the word lists and math level. Interests show up in word searches.

data_description.grade: The grade they read and do math at.
data_description.interests: Free text, for example: dinosaurs, space, horses.
data_description.spelling_words: Optional. Typed list (commas or new lines), used when no to-do list is chosen or it can't be read.
data_description.spelling_todo: Optional. A to-do list with one word per item. Check a word off once it's learned; the spelling prints use the unchecked words.

data_description.grade: The grade they read and do math at.
data_description.interests: Free text, for example: dinosaurs, space, horses.
data_description.spelling_words: Optional. Typed list (commas or new lines), used when no to-do list is chosen or it can't be read.
data_description.spelling_todo: Optional. A to-do list with one word per item. Check a word off once it's learned; the spelling prints use the unchecked words.

kid_limits.title: Kid-mode limits
kid_limits.description: Limits apply to kid prints (maze, word search, math, joke, fun fact, kid pack) from every button, dashboard card, voice phrase and Siri shortcut. Parents can skip them with `ignore_limits: true` on an action. Counts reset at midnight.

data_description.limit_admins_skip: Leave off if a shared wall tablet is signed in as an admin.

error.name_exists: A profile with this name already exists.

options.kid_pack: Kid pack (maze, word search and math)

printer_offline.title: {name} has been offline for a day
printer_offline.description: Home Assistant hasn't reached the receipt printer since {since}. Check that it's switched on and connected, and that its IP address hasn't changed. This message clears itself once the printer answers again.

not_loaded.message: No Tiny Press printer is set up and loaded.

entry_not_found.message: That Tiny Press printer isn't set up or isn't loaded.

choose_printer.message: More than one Tiny Press printer is set up. Choose one with config_entry_id.

print_failed.message: The printer didn't take the job: {error}

path_not_allowed.message: {path} isn't allowed. Use a file under /media or /config/www.

image_not_found.message: {path} isn't an image file Tiny Press can read.

rate_limited_cooldown.message: Just a moment! The next print is ready at {time}.

rate_limited_hour.message: That's lots of printing for now. Try again at {time}.

rate_limited_day.message: That's enough printing for today! See you tomorrow.

rate_limited_paper.message: Today's paper is all used up. See you tomorrow!

no_answers.message: There's no answer key for {print_id}. Answer keys are kept for the last 20 puzzles.

weather_not_set.message: Choose a weather entity under Configure → Settings to print the weather.

no_spelling_words.message: {profile} has no spelling words yet. Add them to the spelling to-do list or under Configure → Edit a profile, or pass words to the action.

all_words_learned.message: {profile} has learned every word on the spelling list. Add new words (or uncheck some) to print more practice.

no_story_in_progress.message: {profile} has no story in progress. Start one with Bedtime story in choose-your-own-adventure mode.

story_preview.message: Stories can't be previewed. Print one with tiny_press.print_story.

morning_once_a_day.message: The morning slip has already been printed from the kid dashboard today. See you tomorrow!

morning_preview.message: The morning slip can't be previewed. Print it with tiny_press.print_morning_slip.

history_unavailable.message: History needs the Recorder integration, which isn't running.

history_bad_period.message: The start of the period must be before the end.

print.name: Print
print.description: Prints a puzzle or page. Every button and voice phrase uses this action.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Kid profile for kid prints, adult profile for sudoku, crossword, cryptogram and puzzle pack. Empty uses the profile selects.

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Loose words work: easy, medium, hard, harder, tricky. Empty uses the difficulty selects or the adult profile's default (kid sudoku: the kid's grade).

seed.name: Seed
seed.description: Prints the same puzzle again for the same seed. Jokes with a seed come from the bundled list.

ignore_limits.name: Ignore kid limits
ignore_limits.description: For parents' scripts and dashboards: print even if kid-mode limits would block it.

words.name: Spelling words
words.description: For spelling prints: words to practice. Empty uses the kid's spelling to-do list (unchecked words), then the typed list.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

text.name: Text
text.description: The text to print. Line breaks are kept.

print_image.name: Print image
print_image.description: Prints a picture, dithered to black and white.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

path.name: Path
path.description: An image under /media or /config/www, for example /config/www/drawing.png.

preview.name: Preview
preview.description: Draws a print without printing it and returns the picture (a PNG data URI) and its seed. Call Print with the same seed to print exactly what you saw.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Kid profile for kid prints, adult profile for sudoku, crossword, cryptogram and puzzle pack. Empty uses the profile selects.

difficulty.name: Difficulty
difficulty.description: Loose words work: easy, medium, hard, harder, tricky. Empty uses the difficulty selects or the adult profile's default (kid sudoku: the kid's grade).

seed.name: Seed

words.name: Spelling words
words.description: For spelling prints: words to practice. Empty uses the kid's spelling to-do list (unchecked words), then the typed list.

print_answers.name: Print answers
print_answers.description: Prints the answer key for the newest puzzle, or for a puzzle ID from its footer (like K7Q2).

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

print_id.name: Puzzle ID
print_id.description: The 4-character ID printed in the footer. Leave empty for the newest puzzle.

print_story.name: Print bedtime story
print_story.description: Prints a bedtime story from your AI task entity (or a bundled story if there isn't one), written for the kid's reading grade. Serial mode starts a choose-your-own-adventure.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

profile.name: Kid
profile.description: Kid profile name. Empty uses the Kid profile select. The kid's name is never sent to the AI.

topic.name: Topic
topic.description: Optional theme, for example dragons or a trip to the moon.

length.name: Length
length.description: Short, medium or long. Empty uses the Story length select.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: One story, or start a choose-your-own-adventure series.

ignore_limits.name: Ignore kid limits
ignore_limits.description: For parents' scripts and dashboards: print even if kid-mode limits would block it.

continue_story.name: Continue story
continue_story.description: Prints the next chapter of the kid's choose-your-own-adventure.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

profile.name: Kid
profile.description: Kid profile name. Empty uses the Kid profile select. The kid's name is never sent to the AI.

choice.name: Choice
choice.description: A or B, as circled on the last chapter. Empty: the gentler option.

final.name: Final chapter
final.description: Wrap the story up with a cozy ending.

length.name: Length
length.description: Short, medium or long. Empty uses the Story length select.

ignore_limits.name: Ignore kid limits
ignore_limits.description: For parents' scripts and dashboards: print even if kid-mode limits would block it.

print_morning_slip.name: Print morning slip
print_morning_slip.description: Prints today's date, weather, calendar events, optional to-dos and a joke, fun fact or small puzzle. Manual only. It doesn't count toward kid-mode limits.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

kid_mode.name: Kid mode
kid_mode.description: Set by kid-mode dashboard cards: allows one morning slip per day.

print_history.name: Print history
print_history.description: Prints the history of one to three entities over a period: a graph (or a timeline for on/off sensors) with a summary, and optionally a table.

config_entry_id.name: Printer
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when more than one Tiny Press printer is set up.

entity_id.name: Entities
entity_id.description: One to three entities. Numeric sensors with the same unit share a graph.

days.name: Days
days.description: How many days back, instead of hours. Periods over 3 days use hourly statistics.

start.name: Start
start.description: Start of a specific period (instead of hours or days).

end.name: End
end.description: End of the period. Default: now.

style.name: Style
style.description: Graph and summary (default), table and summary, or both.

tall.name: Tall graph
tall.description: Draw the graph long and turn it onto the strip: turn the receipt sideways to read it, header at the bottom and time running along the paper. Good for several days.

title.name: Title
title.description: Optional heading. Default: the entities' names.

grid.name: Grid
grid.description: Add time gridlines and a frame to the graph.
